limit: One ordinary game, at most 135 samples, stop at first spare loss.
pass_criterion: At least 99% of all consecutive policy applications must yield consumed transitions exactly four native ticks apart, including all detected misses. The counted primary measure uses the entire original per-tick recording buffer and an alternating focus-bit marker; each real X11 decision therefore has a distinct consumed edge.
scope: Engineering-only audit. Current single-state human SFT weights unchanged, all four heads run; physical focus alternates to witness every boundary. Two registered X pulses. Never enter training or benchmark.
scheduling: Warm model before native actor entry. First policy application anchors the schedule. Capture nominally two native ticks before application, hold until exact absolute native target from live recording object. Report camera and X11 gate misses, per-tick consumed intervals, coverage and wall time.
